description.zh: 重复 name 独立直达 — 不同 name 各自生成独立全局引用：window.x 与 window.y 分别指向对应 img 元素（唯一命中返回元素本身，不产生集合；要得到集合需多个同名元素）。判据：window.x、window.y 均求值为对应 img 元素。
description.en: Two names produce a collection. Success: window.x contains y.

description.zh: 单标签双属性直达 — 单标签同时以 id 与 name 暴露两个全局引用：window.x 与 window.y 均指向该锚点。判据：window.x、window.y 求值为同一元素；锚点无命名属性 getter，x.y 形态不可达。
description.en: One anchor exposing both. Success: x.y reachable.

description.zh: id/name 覆盖 — 以重复 id/name 与表单元素构造命名属性覆盖；form 的命名属性仅解析 button/fieldset/input/object/output/select/textarea 等表单控件（命令清单中 img/audio/video/source/embed/applet/marquee 不参与 form 命名解析，仅当其 name/id 直接命中 window 引用时有效）。脚本读取到的属性变为注入值（如 URL 指向收集域）即确认重复命名覆盖成立。
description.en: Build named-property overrides with duplicate id/name and form elements; script-read properties returning injected values (URLs pointing at the collector) confirm duplicate-name clobbering.

description.zh: location 属性覆盖（仅遗留引擎）— window.location 与 document.location 是 LegacyUnforgeable 自有属性，现代浏览器中命名元素无法覆盖，读取始终得到原生 Location 对象；该形态仅对未实现该保护的历史浏览器有效。判据：仅在遗留浏览器中 document.location 求值为元素，现代浏览器预期为负结果。
description.en: Clobbers document.location. Success: document.location resolves to the anchor.

description.zh: form 深层覆盖 — 构造 cookie.href 引用劫持。判据：document.cookie 求值为 form 元素、document.cookie.href 求值为 input 元素，其 value 为攻击域；消费点需读取 .value 或经字符串拼接才会得到域名字符串。
description.en: Builds cookie.href chain. Success: document.cookie.href returns the attacker URL.

description.zh: top 属性覆盖（仅遗留引擎）— window.top 是 LegacyUnforgeable 自有属性，现代浏览器中命名元素无法覆盖，window.top 始终指向顶层浏览上下文；仅历史浏览器可能被劫持。判据：仅遗留引擎中 window.top 求值为元素且跳转逻辑失效，现代浏览器预期为负结果。
description.en: Clobbers window.top to defeat frame checks. Success: window.top is the anchor.

description.zh: parent 属性覆盖（仅遗留引擎）— window.parent 是 LegacyUnforgeable 自有属性，现代浏览器中命名元素无法覆盖；仅历史浏览器可能命中。判据：仅遗留引擎中 parent 求值为锚点，现代浏览器预期为负结果。
description.en: Clobbers window.parent. Success: parent resolves to the anchor.

description.zh: iframe self 覆盖（仅遗留引擎）— window.self 是 LegacyUnforgeable 自有属性，现代浏览器中 iframe 的 name 无法覆盖；仅历史浏览器可能命中。判据：仅遗留引擎中 window.self 指向 frame，现代浏览器预期为负结果。
description.en: iframe name clobbers self. Success: window.self is the frame.

description.zh: globalThis 覆盖（仅遗留引擎）— globalThis 是全局对象自有属性，命名属性只能进入原型链，现代浏览器中无法被命名元素遮蔽；仅缺乏该实现的旧引擎可能命中。判据：仅遗留引擎中 globalThis 求值为元素，现代浏览器预期为负结果。
description.en: Clobbers globalThis. Success: it resolves to the anchor.

description.zh: 以属性选择器按前缀构造背景请求；首轮单字符规则命中即确定首字符，随后逐轮扩展规则（如 input[value^="ab"]、input[value^="abc"]）继续匹配下一字符，{ATTACKER_HOST} 按轮次收到的请求序列拼接即为字段值，确认逐字符外带成立。逐条渲染并记录命中字符顺序。
description.en: Build per-character background requests with attribute selectors; the character-ordered requests reaching {ATTACKER_HOST} reassemble the field value, confirming character-by-character exfiltration. Render each rule and record the hit order.

description.zh: 属性值目标探测 — 对 CSRF token 常见字符集布网。判据：按命中的 unicode-range 请求得到 token 的字符集合（字符存在性与大致字符域）；顺序与完整值需配合逐前缀选择器等其他 oracle 继续推断。
description.en: Range net across token charsets. Success: token rebuilt from hit requests.

description.zh: 以 @font-face unicode-range 把字符命中映射到字体请求。@font-face 必须配合应用规则才会触发下载：需同时注入选择器规则（如 *{font-family:poc} 或对目标元素设置 font-family:poc），浏览器在渲染命中码位的文本时才发起对应字体请求；{ATTACKER_HOST} 收到的请求即指示命中字符，确认 Unicode 范围外带成立。下方 WAF 变体同样需要应用规则配合。
description.en: Map character hits to font requests with @font-face unicode-range; requests arriving at {ATTACKER_HOST} indicate the matched characters, confirming Unicode-range exfiltration.

description.zh: 把外发与事件载荷注入评论等存储点，等待管理员查看触发；管理员会话执行 marker（弹出标记或自有端点收到不含敏感数据的标记请求）即确认高权限查看页存储型 XSS 成立。命令中的 document.cookie 外发形态仅用于证明可读取性，正式测试须按前置要求替换为固定 marker 后再提交。
description.en: Inject exfil and event payloads into stored points such as comments and wait for an administrator view; execution in the admin session with data or markers arriving at {ATTACKER_HOST} confirms stored XSS on the privileged view. {ATTACKER_HOST} renders to your collection domain and payloads carry only test data.

description.zh: 经 WebSocket 向各消息信封注入富文本载荷与外发样例；消息被渲染为 HTML 后载荷执行，或 {ATTACKER_HOST} 收到 cookie（{ATTACKER_HOST} 指向本地隔离收集器，非真实外传），即确认富文本上下文 XSS 成立。
description.en: Inject rich-text context and exfil payloads over WebSocket; execution after formatted rendering or cookies arriving at {ATTACKER_HOST} confirms the rich-text XSS context. {ATTACKER_HOST} renders to the isolated collector.

description.zh: 实体形式的载荷可绕过对 <、script 的黑名单检查；若服务端在入库或输出前把实体解码一次且渲染时未转义，还原出的标签即被执行。判据：实体被还原为标签并在二次渲染后执行。
description.en: Decoded twice across server and client. Success: executes on second render.

description.zh: 协议相对地址 — PHP 的 include/require 对无 scheme 的 // 开头路径按本地文件处理，通常不会发起远程请求；该形式仅对经 HTTP 客户端解析 URL 的模板加载器有效。保留作对照探测：仅当远程 marker 内容被包含时才判为成功。
description.en: Omit the scheme so // resolves as http in the include context past prefix blacklists; the remote marker being included confirms success.

description.zh: 转换链叠加 — 绕过对单一 base64 过滤器特征的检测：先 ROT13 再 Base64 双层转换，输出为 Base64(ROT13(源码))；先 Base64 解码、再做一次 ROT13 得到源码即成功。
description.en: Stack ROT13 before base64 against single-filter signatures; decoding and reversing the output yields the source, confirming success.

title.en: Multipart Body into Stream

description.zh: 表单编码体 — 绕过对 text/plain 请求体形态的检测：改用 application/x-www-form-urlencoded 携带数据，php://input 仍能读取原始请求体（multipart/form-data 请求体会被 SAPI 消费、php://input 读不到，勿用该形态）；响应回显 marker 即成功。
description.en: Carry the data as multipart, still readable via php://input, past plain-body detection; an effective inclusion confirms success.

description.zh: 该请求只提交位于请求体的纯文本 marker，不涉及任何工作目录文件；结合 wrapper 与请求字节日志判断。命中判据：响应体回显请求体中的 PAYLOADER_MARKER，证明请求体经 php://input 流被包含读取（纯文本 marker 仅被输出，不构成代码执行）。
description.en: This request reads only the working-directory PAYLOADER_MARKER and must be evaluated with final-path or wrapper logs. Success check: the body echoes the request-body PAYLOADER_MARKER, proving php://input was included and executed.

title.en: Session Path Double-Write

description.zh: 冗余段变形 — 绕过对 sessions/sess_ 直达路径的精确匹配：插入 ./ 冗余段不改变最终解析路径；会话内容回显即成功。
description.en: Use double-write traversal that still lands on the session file; identical content being read confirms success.

description.zh: proc 根别名串联 — 绕过对 /proc/self/cwd 字面黑名单：/proc/self/root 指向进程根目录而非工作目录，需再串联 /proc/self/cwd 才回到原目标；marker 文件读取成功即成功。
description.en: Anchor via the /proc/self/root alias instead, past cwd-path blacklists; a successful marker read confirms success.

description.zh: 逐行按引擎指纹提交（${ }、{{ }}、<% %>、#{ } 等形态）；出现 49、config 或命令输出即确认对应引擎把输入当模板求值。命令执行与文件读取样例行仅在授权实验环境执行，验证时优先以 id 等无害命令和固定 marker 替代真实文件读取。
description.en: Submit engine fingerprints line by line (${ }, {{ }}, <% %>, #{ } forms); 49, config, or command output appearing confirms that engine evaluates input as template. Command-execution lines run only in an authorized lab with isolated markers, never reading real files.

description.zh: Smarty 单花括号风格探测，避开 {{ 与 ${ 规则。判据：输出 49。
description.en: FreeMarker-style probe avoiding {{ rules. Success: prints 49.

description.zh: 逐行提交四种花括号/插值形态；任一表达式输出 49、或 {{7*'7'}} 输出 7777777，即确认对应引擎把输入当模板求值，可据此选定引擎专属集合继续验证。
description.en: Submit the four brace/interpolation forms line by line; 49 in the output confirms that engine evaluates input as template, selecting the engine-specific set for follow-up.

description.en: Encodes the link-local address as numeric entities to evade the 169.254 plaintext blacklist. Success: the metadata service is still requested after parsing.

description.zh: PUBLIC 外部子集变体 — 改用 DOCTYPE 的 PUBLIC 形式引用外部子集，载荷不出现 SYSTEM "http 与参数实体特征；成功判据：{LAB_OAST} 收到 x.dtd 请求。
description.en: Encodes the first scheme character as a hex character reference to hide the http:// literal. Success: the external DTD request reaches OAST.

description.zh: workbook.xml 部件变体 — 实体引用放入 definedNames 的元素内容而非 sharedStrings，绕过对 si/t 节点的定向扫描（注意：外部实体不能置于 sheet name 等属性值位）；成功判据：定义名文本、转换错误或解析日志含文件内容。
description.en: Uses the entity in the sheet name attribute to bypass sharedStrings-focused scanning. Success: sheet name or error message contains file contents.

description.zh: 样式表部件变体 — 在 styles 部件的元素内容处引用实体（formatCode 属性位不可用：外部实体禁止出现在属性值）；实体展开发生在 XML 解析期，即使样式层丢弃该节点，文件读取仍已发生；成功判据：worker 文件审计或解析日志出现对 /etc/hostname 的读取，或样式相关错误信息含主机名。
description.en: Injects the entity into a custom format-code attribute to evade detection of si/t nodes. Success: file contents leak when a cell is formatted.

description.zh: 内容类型部件变体 — 包级 [Content_Types].xml 最早被解析，用内部参数实体在包加载阶段发起外链，早于表单数据部件检查点（Extension 属性位不可用：外部实体禁止出现在属性值）；成功判据：{LAB_OAST} 收到 ct.dtd 请求即证明包级部件外链未被拦截。
description.en: Triggers resolution in the package-level Content_Types part before form-data checkpoints. Success: package load error reveals file contents.

description.zh: 参数实体间接变体 — 间接展开逻辑放入外部 DTD，本地 sharedStrings 只留 DOCTYPE SYSTEM 引用，规避 SYSTEM "gopher 直连特征（内部子集内参数实体套用会被一致性解析器直接拒绝）；成功判据：自有 resolver 或目标端口收到单次请求。
description.en: Expands the gopher reference through a parameter entity to evade the direct SYSTEM "gopher signature. Success: the Redis port receives INFO.

description.zh: 以 SharedStrings 实体承载 expect:// 包装器；导入后响应、单元格或日志中出现命令输出（如 uid=…）即确认 expect 包装器可执行命令。验证时优先用无副作用的 echo 随机 marker 命令代替 id（expect:// 本身必然产生子进程），仅在授权且必要时使用原命令。
description.en: Carry the expect:// wrapper in a SharedStrings entity; the wrapper returning the current job marker confirms the expect execution boundary. Never run the source id command — use only a no-child-process test wrapper.

description.en: Uses the entity in a style-name attribute to evade body-content inspection. Success: the styles subsystem leaks the hostname.

description.zh: env 内插域名变体 — 目标侧 USER 环境变量值经 env 查找内插为子域前缀，查找串中无完整外部域名明文；成功判据：{ATTACKER_HOST} 收到带用户名前缀的解析。
description.en: Interpolates the host via an env lookup so no full external domain appears literally. Success: oast.example.com receives a query prefixed with the username.

description.zh: 标签值改为 builtins.exec 动态执行字符串，规避 os.system/subprocess 等函数名特征；成功判据：加载时返回执行结果。
description.en: Points the tag at exec for dynamic string execution so the command never appears inline. Success: loading returns execution output.

title.zh: 单元素/嵌套列表参数形态变体
title.en: PyYAML deserialization tags

description.zh: os.system/os.popen 以单元素列表、subprocess 系列以嵌套列表传参，改变参数结构特征以规避按完整命令字符串或固定括号形态编写的检测规则；成功判据：yaml.load 按标签执行并返回命令输出。
description.en: PyYAML deserialization tags contain multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences. Success check: yaml.load executes per the tags and returns command output.

description.en: Gzipping hides both the magic bytes and gadget structure. Success: target executes id on deserialization (verify via DNS/OAST).

description.en: Weak typing yields 0/NaN depending on engine. Success: any evaluation proves injection.

description.zh: 参数实体 DTD 变体 — 包装逻辑放入外部 DTD，本地 stylesheet 只留 DOCTYPE SYSTEM 引用，规避通用实体 SYSTEM file 直连特征（内部子集内参数实体套用会被一致性解析器拒绝）；成功判据：XSLT 输出含文件内容。
description.en: Expands file contents indirectly via a parameter entity to evade the general-entity SYSTEM file signature. Success: XSLT output contains file contents.

description.zh: value-of document() 变体 — 完全不用 DOCTYPE，改用 XSLT document() 函数读取 XML 配置文件（document() 会把目标按 XML 解析，纯文本文件如 passwd 会解析失败）；成功判据：转换结果含 XML 配置节点内容。
description.en: Drops DOCTYPE entirely and reads via the XSLT document() function. Success: transform output contains passwd contents.

description.zh: 每行需先匹配实际语言和处理器；执行版本不得接受 cmd 参数，只允许固定标记输出。最后一条不是标准 C# 语句，必须由已确认支持 eval 的动态运行时（如 JScript.NET 页面）解释。
description.en: Match each line to the actual language and handler first; the execution version must accept no cmd input and may emit only a fixed marker. The final two are not standard C# statements and require a confirmed dynamic runtime that supports eval.

title.en: Validation step 1 for Cloudflare Path-Extension Cache Differential

description.zh: 把内部路径覆盖头逐条注入并观察缓存；内部路径响应被写入公共缓存键，即确认内部路径未入键。
description.en: Inject each internal-path override header and observe caching; internal-path responses written under public cache keys confirm unkeyed internal paths.

description.en: Inject each X-Rewrite-URL variant; cache and origin disagreeing on rewritten routes confirms rewrite-route cache mismatch.

description.en: Inject each derived-scheme value; caches generating or selecting resources per the injected scheme confirm unkeyed derived schemes.

description.zh: 把缓存指令逐条置于请求并核对响应缓存行为；指令被接受并延长共享缓存寿命，即确认缓存资格差异。
description.en: Place each cache directive into requests and compare caching behavior; directives accepted with extended shared-cache lifetime confirm cache-eligibility differences.

description.zh: 把 Akamai 内部头变体逐条注入；边缘按伪造头改变路由或缓存决策，即确认边缘头信任。
description.en: Inject each Akamai internal-header variant; the edge changing routing or caching decisions per spoofed headers confirms edge-header trust.

description.zh: 逐条将内网地址作为请求目标提交并记录响应；成功时受控模拟路由器/标记服务返回带唯一令牌的特征内容，且连接源为目标服务器，即确认 Host 派生 SSRF 成立。
description.en: Submit each internal address as the request target and record responses; gateway or router admin pages returning signature content confirms Host-derived SSRF.

description.zh: 逐条提交上述 JSON 样例并记录响应与日志差异。命中判据：污染属性被子进程选项继承并执行指定模块或命令。
description.en: Run this Node.js Prototype Pollution to Process Options validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline. Success check: the polluted property is inherited by child-process options and runs the given module or command.

description.zh: 逐条发送 WS 请求调度消息并记录响应与出站日志；成功时服务端代为取回对应 URL 并返回内容，含 file 或 gopher 时确认协议转发。
description.en: Send each WS request-dispatch message and record responses and egress logs; the server fetching the URL and returning content, including file or gopher schemes, confirms protocol forwarding.

patches.expectedCommand:
// 帧1 (opcode=text, FIN=0): {"type":"request","url":"http://127
// 帧2 (opcode=0 continuation, FIN=1): .0.0.1/"}

description.zh: 把消息级认证绕过载荷逐条经 WebSocket 发送；服务端按伪造消息提升会话或返回受限数据，即确认消息级授权缺失。
description.en: Send each message-level auth-bypass payload over WebSocket; the server elevating the session or returning restricted data per forged messages confirms missing message-level authorization.

description.zh: Git泄露包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。命中判据：路径返回 200 且内容特征匹配（HEAD 含 ref、config 含 [core] 段）。
description.en: Run this Exposed Git Metadata Path Probes validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline. Success check: the path returns 200 with matching content signatures (HEAD carrying a ref, config with a [core] section).

description.zh: SVN泄露包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。命中判据：路径返回 200 且 wc.db 为 SQLite 文件头。
description.en: Run this Exposed SVN Working-Copy Metadata Probes validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline. Success check: the path returns 200 and wc.db carries the SQLite file header.

description.zh: 其他源码泄露包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。命中判据：路径返回 200 且内容为对应清单或配置格式。
description.en: Run this Project Build, Dependency, and CI File Exposure Probes validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline. Success check: the path returns 200 with the matching manifest or configuration format.
